info.description: Definitive Healthcare Corp. engages in the provision of healthcare commercial intelligence. Its solution offers information on healthcare providers and their activities to help the customers optimize from product development to go-to-market planning, sales, and marketing execution. The company was founded by Jason Kranzt in February 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Definitive Healthcare Corp. 從事提供醫療保健商業情報。其解決方案提供有關醫療保健提供者及其活動的信息，以幫助客戶優化從產品開發到上市規劃、銷售和行銷執行的整個過程。該公司由 Jason Kranzt 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PBR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of PBR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PBR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PBR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PBR ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 PBR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in drug research and development to create new therapies for fibrotic disease, severe skin disease, and cancer. Its programs target the development of carbohydrate molecules which offers alternative options to larger market segments. The company was founded by James C. Czirr and Anatole A. Klyosov on July 10, 2000 and is headquartered in Norcross, GA.
info.description_zh: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於藥物研發，為纖維化疾病、嚴重皮膚病和癌症創造新療法。其計劃的目標是開發碳水化合物分子，為更大的細分市場提供替代選擇。該公司由 James C. Czirr 和 Anatole A. Klyosov 於 2000 年 7 月 10 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州諾克羅斯。

info.description: Intrusion, Inc. is a cybersecurity company, which offers customers access to its exclusive threat intelligence database containing the historical data, known associations, and reputational behavior of Internet Protocol addresses. Its solutions include INTRUSION Shield, INTRUSION TraceCop, and INTRUSION Savant. The company was founded by T. Joe Head and G. Ward Paxton in September 1983 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Intrusion, Inc. 是一家網路安全公司，為客戶提供存取其獨家威脅情報資料庫的權限，其中包含網際網路協定位址的歷史資料、已知關聯和聲譽行為。其解決方案包括 INTRUSION Shield、INTRUSION TraceCop 和 INTRUSION Savant。該公司由 T. Joe Head 和 G. Ward Paxton 於 1983 年 9 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: MetaVia, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing and commercializing multi-modal disease-modifying therapies. Its pipeline includes ANA001, a proprietary oral niclosamide formulation, Gemcabene, which is assessed as an acute indication for COVID-19, NB-01, a treatment for painful diabetic neuropathy, and NB-02, which has the potential to treat the symptoms of cognitive impairment and modify the progression of neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded on October 30, 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: MetaVia, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發和商業化多模式疾病緩解療法。其產品線包括 ANA001（一種專有的口服氯硝柳胺製劑）、Gemcabene（被評估為 COVID-19 的急性適應症）、NB-01（一種治療疼痛性糖尿病神經病變的藥物）和 NB-02（有潛力治療認知障礙症狀並改變神經退化性疾病的進展）。該公司成立於2014年10月30日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Conduent, Inc. delivers digital business solutions and services spanning the commercial, government and transportation spectrum creating valuable outcomes for clients and the millions of people who count on them. The cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, automation and advanced analytics deliver mission-critical solutions. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Industries, Government Services, and Transportation. The Commercial Industries segment offers business process services and customized solutions to clients in a variety of industries. The Government Services segment is involved in government-centric business process services and subject matter experts to U.S. federal, state, and local and foreign governments. The Transportation segment includes systems and support to transportation departments and agencies globally. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.

info.description: SNDL, Inc. is a licensed producer that crafts small-batch cannabis using state-of-the-art indoor facilities. It operates through the following segments: Liquor Retail, Cannabis Retail, Cannabis Operations, and Investments. The Liquor Retail segment consists of wines, beers, and spirits through owned liquor stores. The Cannabis Retail segment comprises of the private sale of adult-use cannabis through owned and franchise retail cannabis stores. The Cannabis Operations covers the cultivation, distribution and sale of cannabis for the adult-use, and medical markets domestically and for export. The Investments segment includes the deployment of capital to investment opportunities. The company was founded by Stanley J. Swiatek on August 19, 2006 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: SNDL, Inc. 是一家獲得許可的生產商，使用最先進的室內設施生產小批量大麻。它透過以下部門運作：酒類零售、大麻零售、大麻營運和投資。酒類零售部門透過自有酒類商店銷售葡萄酒、啤酒和烈酒。大麻零售部門包括透過自營和特許零售大麻商店私人銷售成人用大麻。大麻業務涵蓋供成人使用以及國內和出口醫療市場使用的大麻的種植、分銷和銷售。投資部門包括將資本部署到投資機會。該公司由Stanley J. Swiatek於2006年8月19日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: The Eastern Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of engineered solutions. The firm primarily provides engineered solutions support in the commercial transportation and logistics markets. The company was founded by Eben Tuttle in October 1858 and is headquartered in Shelton, CT.
info.description_zh: The Eastern Co. 從事工程解決方案的設計、製造和銷售。該公司主要為商業運輸和物流市場提供工程解決方案支援。該公司由 Eben Tuttle 於 1858 年 10 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州謝爾頓。

info.description: Quantum Cyber NV engages in assembling an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered, quantum-accelerated system-of-systems autonomous defense platform. It integrates drone warfare, counter-UAS, autonomous naval mine countermeasures, EMP shielding, anti-drone ammunition, command-and-control, and quantum antenna applications. The company was founded on March 8, 2021 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Quantum Cyber​​ NV 致力於組裝由人工智慧 (AI) 驅動、量子加速的系統級系統自主防禦平台。它整合了無人機作戰、反無人機、自主水雷對抗、電磁脈衝屏蔽、反無人機彈藥、指揮控制和量子天線應用。該公司成立於 2021 年 3 月 8 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation by actively investing in equity securities of energy-related companies or instruments providing exposure to energy-related companies. The strategy targets full market capitalization representation across the energy sector to minimize tracking error and performance deviation relative to traditional broad sector benchmarks.
info.description_zh: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF 透過積極投資能源相關公司的股本證券或提供能源相關公司曝險的工具來尋求長期資本增值。該策略的目標是整個能源行業的完整市值代表性，以最大限度地減少相對於傳統廣泛行業基準的追蹤誤差和績效偏差。

info.description: Bunge Global SA engages in agribusiness including food and ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Agribusiness, Refined & Specialty Oils, Milling, Sugar & Bioenergy, and Corporate & Other. The Agribusiness segment is an integrated, global business principally involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, processing and sale of agricultural commodities and commodity products. The Refined & Specialty Oils segment includes businesses that sell vegetable oils and fats, including cooking oils, shortenings, specialty ingredients, and renewable diesel feedstocks. The Milling segment refers to the businesses that sell wheat flours, bakery mixes, and corn-based products. The Sugar & Bioenergy segment consists of results from the company's previously owned 50% ownership interest in BP Bunge Bioenergia. The Corporate & Other segment focuses on the salaries and overhead for corporate functions that are not allocated to individual reporting segments because the operating performance of such reporting segments is evaluated. It connects farmers to consumers to deliver essential and sustainable food, feed and fuel. The company was founded on February 14, 2023 and is headquartered in Chesterfield, MO.
info.description_zh: Bunge Global SA 從事農業綜合業務，包括食品和配料。它透過以下部門運作：農業綜合企業、精煉和特種油、製粉、糖和生物能源以及企業和其他部門。農業綜合企業部門是一家綜合性、全球性企業，主要涉及農產品和大宗商品的採購、儲存、運輸、加工和銷售。精煉和特種油部門包括銷售植物油和脂肪的業務，包括食用油、起酥油、特殊成分和再生柴油原料。製粉部門是指銷售小麥麵粉、烘焙混合物和玉米產品的業務。糖業和生質能源部門包括該公司先前擁有 BP Bunge Bioenergia 50% 股權的表現。公司及其他分部重點關注公司職能的薪資和間接費用，這些職能未分配給各個報告分部，因為要評估此類報告分部的經營業績。它將農民與消費者聯繫起來，提供基本且永續的食品、飼料和燃料。該公司成立於 2023 年 2 月 14 日，總部位於密蘇裡州切斯特菲爾德。

info.description: Global Indemnity Group LLC engages in the provision of diversified insurance and reinsurance services. It operates through the following segments: Agency and Insurance Services, Belmont Core, and Belmont Non-Core. The Agency and Insurance Services segment engages in insurance distribution, underwriting support, claims adjustment and administration, and insurance technology services through managing general agencies and related service entities. The Belmont Core segment engages in operations for ongoing direct insurance and assumed reinsurance products. The Belmont Non-Core segment engages in the insurance company operations for lines of business that have been de-emphasized. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.

info.description_zh: Global Indemnity Group LLC 從事提供多元化保險和再保險服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：代理商和保險服務部門、貝爾蒙特核心部門和貝爾蒙特非核心部門。代理和保險服務部門透過管理一般代理機構和相關服務實體從事保險分銷、承保支援、索賠調整和管理以及保險技術服務。貝爾蒙特核心部門從事持續直接保險和假定再保險產品的業務。貝爾蒙特非核心部門從事已不再強調的業務線的保險公司業務。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of conditionally activated, biologics localized to the tumor microenvironment. The company was founded by Frederick W. Gluck and Nancy E. Stagliano in September 2010 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc.是一家專注於腫瘤學的臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對腫瘤微環境的條件激活生物製劑。該公司由 Frederick W. Gluck 和 Nancy E. Stagliano 於 2010 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Epsilon Energy Ltd. engages in the business of acquiring, developing, gathering, and producing natural gas and oil reserves. It operates through the following segments: Upstream, and Gathering System. The Upstream segment includes the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas reserves. The Gathering System segment deals with natural gas gathering system. The company was founded by Zoran Arandjelovic and John K. Wilson on March 14, 2005 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Epsilon Energy Ltd. 從事收購、開發、收集和生產天然氣和石油儲備的業務。它透過以下部分運作：上游和收集系統。上游部門包括石油和天然氣儲量的收購、勘探、開發和生產。收集系統部門涉及天然氣收集系統。該公司由 Zoran Arandjelovic 和 John K. Wilson 於 2005 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. engages in the production of oilseeds, corn, wheat, cocoa, and other agricultural commodities. It operates through the following segments: Ag Services and Oilseeds, Carbohydrate Solutions, Nutrition, and Other. The Ag Services and Oilseeds segment includes activities related to the origination, merchandising, transportation, and storage of agricultural raw materials, and the crushing and further processing of oilseeds such as soybeans and soft seeds cottonseed, sunflower seed, canola, rapeseed, and flaxseed into vegetable oils and protein meals. The Carbohydrate Solutions segment consists of corn and wheat wet and dry milling and other activities. The Nutrition segment serves various end markets including food, beverages, nutritional supplements, and feed and premix for livestock, aquaculture, and pet food. The Other segment refers to the company's remaining operations. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. 從事油籽、玉米、小麥、可可和其他農產品的生產。它透過以下部門運作：農業服務和油籽部門、碳水化合物解決方案部門、營養部門和其他部門。農業服務和油籽部門包括與農業原料的原產地、銷售、運輸和儲存有關的活動，以及將大豆和軟籽棉籽、葵花籽、油菜籽、油菜籽和亞麻籽等油籽壓榨和深加工成植物油和蛋白粉的活動。碳水化合物解決方案部門包括玉米和小麥的濕磨和乾磨以及其他活動。營養部門服務於各種終端市場，包括食品、飲料、營養補充劑以及牲畜、水產養殖和寵物食品的飼料和預混料。其他部門是指公司的剩餘業務。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: Prothena Corp. Plc is a clinical-stage neuroscience company, which engages in the discovery and development of novel therapies to change the course of devastating diseases. The firm's clinical pipeline includes both wholly owned and partnered programs being developed for the potential treatment of diseases including AL amyloidosis, ATTR amyloidosis, Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded in December 1969 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Prothena Corp. Plc 是一家臨床階段的神經科學公司，致力於發現和開發新療法以改變破壞性疾病的進程。該公司的臨床管道包括正在開發的全資和合作項目，用於潛在治療 AL 澱粉樣變性、ATTR 澱粉樣變性、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症和其他神經退化性疾病。該公司成立於1969年12月，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Warner Music Group Corp. engages in the publishing and recording of music. It operates through the Recorded Music and Music Publishing segments. The Recorded Music segment is involved in the sale, marketing, distribution, and licensing of recorded music produced by the company's recording artists. The Music Publishing segment acts as a copyright owner and/or administrator of the musical compositions and generates revenues related to the exploitation of musical compositions. The company was founded on November 21, 2003 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 華納音樂集團公司從事音樂出版和錄製。它透過錄製音樂和音樂出版部門運作。錄製音樂部門涉及公司唱片藝術家製作的錄製音樂的銷售、行銷、分銷和授權。音樂出版部門充當音樂作品的版權所有者和/或管理員，並產生與音樂作品的利用相關的收入。該公司成立於2003年11月21日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Pacira Biosciences, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of non-opioid pain management and regenerative health solutions to improve patients' journeys along the neural pain pathway. Its products include EXPAREL, iovera, and DepoFoam. The company was founded in December 2006 and is headquartered in Brisbane, CA.

info.description: Defiance Oil Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; secondary objective being exposure to the performance of United States Oil Fund, LP ("USO") subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the share price of United States Oil Fund, LP, subject to a limit on potential gains related to increases in the price of USO's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Oil 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；次要目標是了解美國石油基金有限合夥人（「USO」）的業績，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前收入，同時保持間接接觸 United States Oil Fund, LP 股價的機會，但受到與 USO 股價上漲相關的潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GoDaddy, Inc. engages in the provision of simple and easy-to-use products on a single technology platform, complemented by personalized guidance. It operates through the following segments: Applications and Commerce (A&C) and Core Platform (Core). The Applications and Commerce (A&C) segment sells products containing proprietary software, commerce solutions, third-party email services, productivity tools, and certain products bundled with proprietary software offerings. The Core Platform (Core) segment provides domain registrations and renewals, aftermarket domain sales, website hosting services, website security products that are not included in bundled proprietary software offerings, and other products that do not contain a software component. The company was founded by Robert R. Parsons in 1997 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: GoDaddy, Inc. 致力於在單一技術平台上提供簡單易用的產品，並輔以個人化指導。它透過以下部門運作：應用程式和商務（A＆C）以及核心平台（Core）。應用程式和商務 (A&C) 部門銷售的產品包含專有軟體、商務解決方案、第三方電子郵件服務、生產力工具以及與專有軟體產品捆綁在一起的某些產品。核心平台（核心）部門提供網域名稱註冊和續約、售後網域銷售、網站寄存服務、不包含在捆綁專有軟體產品中的網站安全產品以及其他不包含軟體元件的產品。該公司由 Robert R. Parsons 於 1997 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Ascendis Pharma A/S is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of drug candidates. It specializes in its TransCon technologies to develop new therapies that address unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Jan Moller Mikkelsen, Dirk Vetter, and Harald Rau on September 21, 2006 and is headquartered in Hellerup, Denmark.
info.description_zh: Ascendis Pharma A/S 是一家生物製藥公司，從事候選藥物的開發。它專注於 TransCon 技術來開發新療法，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司由 Jan Moller Mikkelsen、Dirk Vetter 和 Harald Rau 於 2006 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於丹麥海勒魯普。

info.description: Cardiff Oncology, Inc. is an oncology therapeutics company, which engages in the development of drugs that target mitosis for the treatment of various types of cancer. The firm is focused on developing onvansertib, a first-in-class, third-generation Polo-like Kinase 1 (PLK1) inhibitor, in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy and targeted therapeutics. Its clinical programs include KRAS-Mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC), Resistant Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC) and relapsed or refractory Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML). The company was founded by Gabriel M. Cerrone, L. David Tomei, Samuil Umansky, and Hovsep Melkonyan in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cardiff Oncology, Inc.是一家腫瘤治療公司，致力於開發針對有絲分裂的藥物，用於治療各種類型的癌症。該公司專注於開發 onvansertib，這是一種一流的第三代 Polo 樣激酶 1 (PLK1) 抑制劑，與標準護理化療和標靶治療相結合。其臨床項目包括 KRAS 突變的轉移性結直腸癌 (mCRC)、抗藥性轉移性去勢抵抗性前列腺癌 (mCRPC) 和復發或難治性急性髓系白血病 (AML)。該公司由 Gabriel M. Cerrone、L. David Tomei、Samuil Umansky 和 ​​Hovsep Melkonyan 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Faeth Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company which focuses on the discovery, development, and delivery of next generation immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer and infectious diseases. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.

info.description: Hennessy Advisors, Inc. engages in the provision of investment advisory services to a family of open-ended mutual funds and an exchange-traded fund. It offers exchange-traded funds, traditional equity, specialty category, and sector funds, as well as more conservative multi-asset products. The company was founded by Neil Joseph Hennessy on February 1, 1989 and is headquartered in Novato, CA.

info.description: Krystal Biotech, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company, which engages in discovery, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of pharmaceutical products. It offers the product, VYJUVEK. The company was founded by Krish S. Krishnan and Suma M. Krishnan on April 15, 2016 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Krystal Biotech, Inc. 是一家生技公司，從事醫藥產品的發現、開發、製造和商業化。它提供產品 VYJUVEK。該公司由 Krish S. Krishnan 和 Suma M. Krishnan 於 2016 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: LENZ Therapeutics, Inc. is a pre-commercial biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development and commercialization of innovative therapies to improve vision. It offers eye drop product treatment for presbyopia. The company was founded by James W. McCollum in July 2013 and is headquartered in Solana Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: LENZ Therapeutics, Inc.是一家預商業化生物製藥公司，專注於改善視力的創新療法的開發和商業化。它提供治療老花眼的眼藥水產品。該公司由 James W. McCollum 於 2013 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州索拉納海灘。

info.description: Seres Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of biological drugs through microbiome therapeutics platform. Its product pipeline includes SER-109, SER-287, SER-301, and SER-401. The company was founded by Geoffrey von Maltzahn, David A. Berry, and Noubar B. Afeyan on October 18, 2010 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Seres Therapeutics, Inc.透過微生物組治療平台從事生物藥物的開發。其產品線包括SER-109、SER-287、SER-301和SER-401。該公司由 Geoffrey von Maltzahn、David A. Berry 和 Noubar B. Afeyan 於 2010 年 10 月 18 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing medicines to target diseases driven by abnormally elevated aldosterone. Its clinical-stage product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor that are initially developing for the treatment of cardiorenal conditions affected by abnormally elevated aldosterone, including hypertension and chronic kidney disease. The company was founded by Brian Taylor Slingsby on May 31, 2019 and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.
info.description_zh: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發針對由醛固酮異常升高引起的疾病的藥物。其臨床階段候選產品lorundrostat是一種專有的口服高選擇性醛固酮合成酶抑制劑，最初開發用於治療受醛固酮異常升高影響的心腎疾病，包括高血壓和慢性腎臟病。該公司由 Brian Taylor Slingsby 於 2019 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州拉德諾。

info.description: Oaktree Acquisition Corp. III Life Sciences is a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Oaktree Acquisition Corp. III Life Sciences 是一家空白支票公司，其創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、資本股票交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of community banking services. It operates through the Banking and Consumer Finance segments. The firm also offers non-banking activities, such as securities underwriting and dealing activities, insurance agency and underwriting activities, and merchant banking and equity investment activities. The company was founded on January 8, 1992 and is headquartered in Gallipolis, OH.
info.description_zh: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，從事提供社區銀行服務。它透過銀行和消費金融部門運作。該公司還提供非銀行業務，例如證券承銷和交易活動、保險代理和承銷活動以及商業銀行和股權投資活動。該公司成立於1992年1月8日，總部位於俄亥俄州加利波利斯。

info.description: TDH Holdings, Inc. is a real estate management company, that focuses on owning, operating and managing commercial real estate properties. It provides office services for small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was founded by Rong Feng Cui on April 22, 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: TDH Holdings, Inc. 是一家房地產管理公司，專注於擁有、經營和管理商業房地產。為中小企業提供辦公服務。該公司由崔榮峰於2002年4月22日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Varonis Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of a security software platform. Its software enables enterprises and industries to protect data stored in the cloud and on-premises including sensitive files and emails, confidential personal data belonging to customers, patients, and employees, financial records, source code, strategic, and product plans, and other intellectual property. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Rest of the World. The company was founded by Yakov Faitelson and Ohad Korkus on November 3, 2004 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Varonis Systems, Inc. 從事提供安全軟體平台。其軟體使企業和行業能夠保護儲存在雲端和本地的數據，包括敏感文件和電子郵件、屬於客戶、患者和員工的機密個人資料、財務記錄、原始程式碼、策略和產品計劃以及其他智慧財產權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東、非洲以及世界其他地區。該公司由 Yakov Faitelson 和 Ohad Korkus 於 2004 年 11 月 3 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Xsolla SPAC 1 is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Aleksandr Agapitov on September 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Sherman Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: Xsolla SPAC 1 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Aleksandr Agapitov 於 2025 年 9 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州謝爾曼奧克斯。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SMCI ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Super Micro Computer Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SMCI ETF 旨在透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收益是透過出售超微電腦公司普通股選擇權產生的，該基金旨在提供 2 倍 (200%) 基礎股票每日表現，並獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 的表現上限，但受潛在投資收益上限，但受潛在投資收益上限的限制。可能會實施下行保護，這可能會影響淨利潤水準。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的槓桿ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. info.description: JPMorgan Managed Futures Plus ETF combines a strategic, long-term large-capitalization U.S. equity exposure with a systematic, model-driven managed futures strategy that takes long and short positions globally across equities, fixed income, currencies, and commodities. The fund implements its multi-asset framework via direct stock investments and substantial derivative exposures, while managing a portion of its commodity risk through a wholly owned Cayman Islands subsidiary.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通管理期貨Plus ETF將戰略性長期大盤美國股票敞口與系統化、模型驅動的管理期貨策略相結合，該策略在全球範圍內持有股票、固定收益、貨幣和大宗商品的多頭和空頭頭寸。該基金透過直接股票投資和大量衍生性商品曝險實施其多元資產框架，同時透過全資擁有的開曼群島子公司管理部分商品風險。

info.description: Gladstone Capital Corp. is real estate investment trust, which owns net leased industrial, commercial, retail property and selectively makes long-term industrial and commercial mortgage loans. It offers debt and equity financing for growth, acquisition and recapitalization with an investment. The company was founded by David J. Gladstone on May 30, 2001 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Gladstone Capital Corp.是一家房地產投資信託公司，擁有淨租賃的工業、商業、零售物業，並選擇性地提供長期工業和商業抵押貸款。它透過投資為成長、收購和資本重組提供債務和股權融資。該公司由 David J. Gladstone 於 2001 年 5 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: RMG ML Sports Holdings is a blank check company, which engages for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on December 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Incline Village, NV.
info.description_zh: RMG ML Sports Holdings 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年12月16日，總部位於內華達州因克萊恩村。

It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VII 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月3日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: DAXOR Corporation is an innovative medical instrumentation and biotechnology company. DAXOR designed and developed the BVA-100 Blood Volume Analyzer. It is the first instrument approved by the FDA to provide rapid direct measurement of a patient's true blood volume. We believe that the BVA-100 Blood Volume Analyzer has the potential to transform therapy in a broad range of surgical and medical conditions. It is our goal, working in conjunction with hospitals and clinics, to achieve that possibility. The BVA-100 is a semi-automated Blood Volume Analyzer. It is used in conjunction with a single use diagnostic kit. It is the first FDA-approved instrument to provide rapid direct measurement of a patient's blood volume.

info.description_zh: DAXOR Corporation 是一家創新醫療儀器和生物技術公司。 DAXOR 設計並開發了 BVA-100 血量分析儀。它是 FDA 批准的第一款能夠快速直接測量患者真實血液量的儀器。我們相信 BVA-100 血量分析儀有潛力改變各種外科和醫療狀況下的治療方法。我們的目標是與醫院和診所合作，以實現這種可能性。 BVA-100 是一款半自動血量分析儀。它與一次性診斷套件結合使用。它是第一款獲得 FDA 批准的可快速直接測量患者血液容積的儀器。

info.description: SBA Communications Corp. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the provision of wireless communications infrastructures. It operates through the following business segments: Domestic Site Leasing, International Site Leasing, and Site Development. The Domestic Site Leasing segment includes AT&T, Sprint, T-Mobile, and Verizon Wireless. The International Site Leasing segment acquires and develops towers. The Site Development segment is involved in consulting and construction activities. The company was founded by Steven E. Bernstein in 1989 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: SBA Communications Corp. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事提供無線通訊基礎設施業務。它透過以下業務部門運作：國內場地租賃、國際場地租賃和場地開發。國內站點租賃部門包括 AT&T、Sprint、T-Mobile 和 Verizon Wireless。國際場地租賃部門收購和開發塔樓。場地開發部門從事諮詢和建設活動。該公司由 Steven E. Bernstein 於 1989 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: S&P Global, Inc. engages in the provision of transparent and independent ratings, benchmarks, analytics, and data to the capital and commodity markets worldwide. It operates through the following segments: Ratings, Indices, Energy, and Market Intelligence. The Ratings segment provides credit ratings, research, and analytics. The Indices segment maintains a wide variety of valuation and index benchmarks for investment advisors, wealth managers, and institutional investors. The Energy segment is involved in information and benchmark prices for the energy and commodity markets. The Market Intelligence segment covers multi-asset-class data and analytics integrated with purpose-built workflow solutions. The company was founded by James H. McGraw and John A. Hill in 1917 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: S&P Global, Inc. 致力於向全球資本和商品市場提供透明和獨立的評級、基準、分析和數據。它透過以下部門運作：評級、指數、能源和市場情報。評級部門提供信用評級、研究和分析。指數部門為投資顧問、財富管理機構和機構投資者維護各種估值和指數基準。能源部門涉及能源和商品市場的資訊和基準價格。市場情報部門涵蓋與專門建構的工作流程解決方案整合的多資產類別資料和分析。該公司由 James H. McGraw 和 John A. Hill 於 1917 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Coherus Oncology, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of biosimilar therapeutics. Its products include UDENYCA and LOQTORZI. The company was founded by Dennis M. Lanfear, Stuart E. Builder, Dr. Alan Herman, Doug Farrar and Steve Glover in September 2010 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Coherus Oncology, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，從事生物相似藥療法的開發和商業化。其產品包括UDENYCA和LOQTORZI。該公司由 Dennis M. Lanfear、Stuart E. Builder、Alan Herman 博士、Doug Farrar 和 Steve Glover 於 2010 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德城。

info.description: First Trust Germany AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Germany Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Germany Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 德國 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 德國指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克德國指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: ScanSource, Inc. engages in the development and provision of technology products and services. It operates through the Specialty Technology Solutions and Intelisys & Advisory segments. The Specialty Technology Solutions segment includes enterprise mobile computing, data capture, barcode printing, POS, payments, networking, electronic physical security, cybersecurity and other technologies. The Intelisys & Advisory segment refers to the United States and consists of sales and services to both channel sales partners (Intelisys) and end users (Advisory). The company was founded by Michael L. Baur and Steven H. Owings in December 1992 and is headquartered in Greenville, SC.
info.description_zh: ScanSource, Inc. 從事技術產品和服務的開發和提供。它透過專業技術解決方案和 Intelisys 與諮詢部門運作。專業技術解決方案部門包括企業行動運算、資料收集、條碼列印、POS、支付、網路、電子實體安全、網路安全和其他技術。 Intelisys 和諮詢部門涉及美國，包括向通路銷售合作夥伴 (Intelisys) 和最終用戶 (Advisory) 提供的銷售和服務。該公司由 Michael L. Baur 和 Steven H. Owings 於 1992 年 12 月創立，總部位於南卡羅來納州格林維爾。

info.description: WEBTOON Entertainment, Inc. engages in the provision of a global storytelling platform. The firm allows creators and users to discover, create, and share new content. Its brands include Munpia, Yonder, Studio Lico, LINE, and Creator Studios. The company was founded by Jun-Koo Kim in 2005 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: WEBTOON Entertainment, Inc. 致力於提供全球說故事平台。該公司允許創作者和用戶發現、創建和分享新內容。旗下品牌包括 Munpia、Yonder、Studio Lico、LINE 和 Creator Studios。該公司由 Jun-Koo Kim 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: enGene Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing gene therapies. It is developing non-viral gene therapies based on its novel and proprietary dually derived chitosan, or DDX, gene delivery platform, which allows localized delivery of multiple gene cargos directly to mucosal tissues and other organs. The company was founded by Anthony T. Cheung on April 24, 2023 and is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Canada.
info.description_zh: enGene Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發基因療法。該公司正在開發基於其新穎且專有的雙衍生殼聚醣（DDX）基因遞送平台的非病毒基因療法，該平台允許將多種基因貨物直接局部遞送至黏膜組織和其他器官。該公司由 Anthony T. Cheung 於 2023 年 4 月 24 日創立，總部位於加拿大聖洛朗。

info.description: Solstice Advanced Materials, Inc. engages in the provision of specialty materials to industries and applications. The firm offers refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging, etc. It operates through the Refrigerants & Applied Solutions (RAS) and Electronic & Specialty Materials (ESM) segments. The RAS segment manufactures low global warming potential (LGWP) refrigerants, blowing agents, solvents, and aerosol materials. The ESM segment serves the semiconductor, defense, pharmaceutical, and construction end markets. The company was founded on October 30, 2025 and is headquartered in Morris Plains, NJ.
info.description_zh: Solstice Advanced Materials, Inc. 致力於為行業和應用提供特殊材料。該公司提供冷媒、半導體製造、資料中心冷卻、核電、防護纖維、醫療保健包裝等。它透過冷媒和應用解決方案（RAS）以及電子和特殊材料（ESM）部門運作。 RAS 部門生產低全球暖化潛值 (LGWP) 冷媒、發泡劑、溶劑和氣溶膠材料。 ESM 部門服務於半導體、國防、製藥和建築終端市場。該公司成立於2025年10月30日，總部位於新澤西州莫里斯普萊恩斯。

info.description: T Stamp, Inc. engages in development of proprietary artificial intelligence-powered solutions. It also focuses on researching and leveraging machine learning artificial intelligence, including computer vision, cryptography, and data mining, to process and protect data for identification against fraud. The company was founded by Gareth Genner, Andrew Gowasack, Catherine Lambert and Mike Lindenau on November 9, 2015 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: T Stamp, Inc. 致力於開發專有的人工智慧驅動解決方案。它還專注於研究和利用機器學習人工智慧，包括電腦視覺、密碼學和資料探勘，來處理和保護資料以防止詐欺。該公司由 Gareth Genner、Andrew Gowasack、Catherine Lambert 和 Mike Lindenau 於 2015 年 11 月 9 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: BlackLine, Inc. engages in providing a cloud-based software platform that automates and controls financial close and accounting processes. It operates through the United States and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Therese Tucker in May 2001 and is headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: BlackLine, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體平台，可自動執行和控制財務結算和會計流程。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Therese Tucker 於 2001 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州伍德蘭希爾斯。

info.description: Materialise NV engages in the provision of additive manufacturing software and 3D printing services. It operates through the following segments: Materialise Software, Materialise Medical, and Materialise Manufacturing. The Materialise Software segment offers proprietary software worldwide through programs and platforms that enable companies to set up reliable and sustainable 3D printing production. The Materialise Medical segment includes medical software solutions, medical devices and other related products and services. The Materialise Manufacturing segment provides 3D printed services to industrial and commercial customers. The company was founded by Wilfried Vancraen and Hilde Ingelaere on June 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Leuven, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Materialise NV 從事提供積層製造軟體和 3D 列印服務。它透過以下部門運作：Materialize Software、Materialise Medical 和 Materialise Manufacturing。 Materialise Software 部門透過程式和平台在全球範圍內提供專有軟體，使公司能夠建立可靠且可持續的 3D 列印生產。 Materialise Medical 部門包括醫療軟體解決方案、醫療設備以及其他相關產品和服務。 Materialise Manufacturing 部門為工業和商業客戶提供 3D 列印服務。該公司由 Wilfried Vancraen 和 Hilde Ingelaere 於 1990 年 6 月 28 日創立，總部位於比利時魯汶。

info.description: Bonk, Inc. is a wellness and dietary supplement company. It has developed Sure Shot, the first patented wellness product on Earth that lowers blood alcohol content by supporting its metabolism, while boosting clarity, energy, and overall mood. The company was founded by Brian S. John on October 24, 2018 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Bonk, Inc. 是一家健康和膳食補充劑公司。該公司開發了 Sure Shot，這是地球上第一個獲得專利的健康產品，透過支持新陳代謝來降低血液中的酒精含量，同時提高清晰度、能量和整體情緒。該公司由 Brian S. John 於 2018 年 10 月 24 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Okta, Inc. engages in the provision of an identity management platform for enterprises. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: United States and International. Its products include single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, access gateway, API access management, authentication, adaptive MFA and lifecycle management. The company was founded by Todd McKinnon and J. Frederic Kerrest in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ Cybersecurity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq CTA Cybersecurity Index TM (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index includes securities of companies classified as "cyber security" companies by CTA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ Cyber​​security ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq CTA Cyber​​security Index TM（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數包括被 CTA 歸類為「網路安全」公司的公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Cybersecurity Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance of the WisdomTree Team8 Cybersecurity Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to equity securities of exchange-listed companies globally, which are primarily involved in cybersecurity and security-oriented technology that generate a meaningful part of their revenue from cybersecurity activities and are experiencing revenue growth. To the extent the index concentrates in the securities of a particular industry or group of industries, the fund will concentrate its investments to approximately the same extent as the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 網路安全基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree Team8 網路安全指數的價格和收益率表現。該指數旨在提供全球交易所上市公司的股本證券敞口，這些公司主要涉及網路安全和安全導向技術，這些公司的收入中有很大一部分來自網路安全活動，並且正在經歷收入成長。如果指數集中於特定產業或產業組的證券，則基金的投資集中程度將與指數大致相同。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Ascentage Pharma Group International Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in the development of novel therapies for cancers, hepatitis B virus, or HBV, and age-related diseases. The company was founded by Da Jun Yang, Wang Shao Meng and Ming Guo in May 2009 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 亞盛醫藥集團國際有限公司是一家臨床階段的生技公司。它致力於開發癌症、乙型肝炎病毒或 HBV 以及與年齡相關的疾病的新療法。該公司由楊大軍、王少萌和郭明於2009年5月創立，總部位於中國蘇州。

info.description: Synopsys, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design automation (EDA) software that engineers use to design and test integrated circuits (ICs). It also offers semiconductor intellectual property (IP) products. It operates through the Design Automation and Design IP segments. The Design Automation segment includes silicon design, verification of products and services, and Ansys products, and system integration of products and services. The Design IP segment refers to interface, foundation, security, and embedded processor IP, IP subsystems, and IP implementation services that serve companies primarily in the semiconductor and electronics industries. The company was founded by Aart J. de Geus, Bill Krieger, Dave Gregory, and Rick Rudell in December 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Synopsys, Inc. 致力於提供工程師用來設計和測試積體電路 (IC) 的電子設計自動化 (EDA) 軟體。它還提供半導體知識產權（IP）產品。它透過設計自動化和設計 IP 部門運作。設計自動化部門包括晶片設計、產品和服務驗證、Ansys 產品以及產品和服務的系統整合。設計IP部分涉及介面、基礎、安全和嵌入式處理器IP、IP子系統和IP實施服務，主要為半導體和電子行業的公司提供服務。該公司由 Aart J. de Geus、Bill Krieger、Dave Gregory 和 Rick Rudell 於 1986 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Polyrizon Ltd. is a development stage biotech company, which engages in the development of nasal hydrogels. It provides barriers from the interaction of biological assaults, including a new strain of coronavirus, influenza, allergens and other airborne pathogens with the nasal epithelial tissue. The company was founded by Tomer Izraeli in January 2005 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.
info.description_zh: Polyrizon Ltd.是一家處於發展階段的生物技術公司，從事鼻腔水凝膠的開發。它為生物攻擊提供了屏障，包括新型冠狀病毒、流感、過敏原和其他空氣傳播的病原體與鼻上皮組織的相互作用。該公司由 Tomer Izraeli 於 2005 年 1 月創立，總部位於以色列 Raanana。

info.description: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cybersecurity seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq CTA Cybersecurity IndexSM. The index is a modified liquidity weighted index comprised of companies classified as "cybersecurity" companies by CTA. The Advisor expects that its cash balances maintained in connection with the use of financial instruments will typically be held in money market instruments. It invests in common stock issued by public companies. The fund invests in derivatives, which are financial instruments whose value is derived from the value of an underlying asset or assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cyber​​security 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於納斯達克 CTA 網路安全指數 SM 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該指數是修改後的流動性加權指數，由 CTA 歸類為「網路安全」公司的公司組成。顧問預計其與使用金融工具相關的現金餘額通常以貨幣市場工具持有。它投資於上市公司發行的普通股。該基金投資於衍生性商品，這些衍生性商品是其價值源自標的資產或資產的價值的金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long CRWD Daily ETF seeks daily inverse investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of CrowdStrike Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: CRWD). The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PANW. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PANW and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PANW 每日業績的 200% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PANW 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 PANW 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description_zh: 美物科技有限公司是一家線上和行動商務公司。該公司在中國從事透過網上零售店銷售食品的業務並經營餐廳。該公司透過以下可報告部門運作：清潔食品平台、技術服務以及護膚產品和服務。公司成立於2018年12月4日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Celularity, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of off-the-shelf placental-derived allogeneic cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and immune and infectious diseases. It operates through the following segments: Cell Therapy, BioBanking, Degenerative Disease, and Other. The Cell Therapy segment consists of the therapies the company is researching and developing. info.description_zh: Celularity, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發現成的胎盤來源同種異體細胞療法，用於治療癌症、免疫和傳染病。它透過以下部門運作：細胞治療、生物銀行、退化性疾病等。細胞療法部門由公司正在研究和開發的療法組成。生物銀行部門專注於來自臍帶和胎盤的幹細胞，並代表個人儲存此類細胞以供將來使用。退化性疾病部門提供外科和傷口護理市場的產品。該公司由 Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新澤西州弗洛勒姆公園。

Its product brands include HERO9 Black, HERO8 Black, Max, HERO7 Black, HERO7 Silver, GoPro Plus, and GoPro App. The company was founded by Nicholas Woodman in 2002 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.

info.description_zh: Avalanche Treasury Corp 是一家數位資產財務公司，專注於持有和管理數位資產投資。該公司成立於2025年9月22日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Purple Biotech Ltd. is a clinical-stage company, which engages in developing first-in-class therapies that seek to overcome tumor immune evasion and drug resistance. The oncology pipeline includes CM24, NT219, and CAPTN-3. The CM24 is a humanized monoclonal antibody that blocks CEACAM1, which supports tumor immune evasion and survival through multiple pathways. The NT219 is a dual inhibitor, novel small molecule that simultaneously targets IRS1/2 and STAT3. The CAPTN-3, a preclinical platform of conditionally activated tri-specific antibodies, which engage both T cells and NK cells to induce a strong, localized immune response within the tumor microenvironment. The company was founded by John Paul Waymack on August 12, 1968 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Purple Biotech Ltd.是一家臨床階段公司，致力於開發一流的療法，旨在克服腫瘤免疫逃脫和抗藥性。腫瘤藥物管線包括 CM24、NT219 和 CAPTN-3。 CM24 是一種人源化單株抗體，可阻斷 CEACAM1，從而透過多種途徑支持腫瘤免疫逃脫和存活。 NT219 是一種雙重抑制劑，是同時針對 IRS1/2 和 STAT3 的新型小分子。 CAPTN-3 是一個由條件活化的三特異性抗體組成的臨床前平台，可與 T 細胞和 NK 細胞結合，在腫瘤微環境中誘導強烈的局部免疫反應。該公司由 John Paul Waymack 於 1968 年 8 月 12 日創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: Fly-E Group, Inc. is an electric vehicle company, which engages in designing, installing, and selling smart electric motorcycles, electric bikes, electric scooters, and related accessories under the brand Fly E-Bike. Its products include electric-scooter, e-bikes, parts, and accessories. The company was founded by Zhou Ou in 2018 and is headquartered in Flushing, NY.
info.description_zh: Fly-E Group, Inc.是一家電動車公司，以Fly E-Bike品牌從事設計、安裝和銷售智慧電動摩托車、電動自行車、電動滑板車及相關配件。其產品包括電動滑板車、電動自行車、零件和配件。該公司由周歐於2018年創立，總部位於紐約法拉盛。

info.description: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. engages in the development of therapeutic products for the treatment of rare and orphan diseases. Its product pipeline includes QRX003, QRX004, QRX007, and QRX008. The company was founded by Michael Myers and Denise Carter on March 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Ashburn, VA.
info.description_zh: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. 從事治療罕見疾病和孤兒疾病的治療產品的開發。其產品線包括QRX003、QRX004、QRX007和QRX008。該公司由 Michael Myers 和 Denise Carter 於 2018 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿什本。

info.description: Cresud SA engages in the production of basic agricultural commodities. It operates through the Agricultural Business, and Urban Properties and Investment Business segments. The Agricultural Business segment engages in the operation of crop production, cattle feeding, raising, fattening and slaughtering, milk production, sugarcane production, brokerage activities, and sale of supplies. The Urban and Investment Business segment comprises of Operation Center in Argentina, which includes shopping malls, offices, sales and development, hotels, international operations, entertainment activities, and corporate activities, and Operation Center in Israel, which consists of real estate, supermarkets, telecommunications, insurance, other diverse business, and holding companies activities. The company was founded on December 31, 1936 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Cresud SA 從事基本農產品的生產。它透過農業業務、城市房地產和投資業務部門運作。農業業務部門從事農作物生產、牛隻飼養、飼養、育肥及屠宰、牛奶生產、甘蔗生產、經紀活動及物資銷售等業務。城市與投資業務部門包括阿根廷營運中心（包括購物中心、辦公大樓、銷售和開發、酒店、國際營運、娛樂活動和企業活動）和以色列營運中心（包括房地產、超市、電信、保險、其他多元化業務和控股公司活動）。該公司成立於1936年12月31日，總部位於阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯。

info.description: Barinthus Biotherapeutics Plc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of antigen-specific immunotherapeutics that induce T cells to treat chronic viral infections, autoimmune diseases, and cancer. It also focuses on the pipeline of both clinical and preclinical stage therapeutic, and prophylactic programs. The company was founded by Adrian Hill and Dame Sarah Gilbert in March 2021 and is headquartered in Didcot, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Barinthus Biotherapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發抗原特異性免疫治療藥物，誘導 T 細胞治療慢性病毒感染、自體免疫疾病和癌症。它還專注於臨床和臨床前階段治療和預防計劃的管道。該公司由 Adrian Hill 和 Dame Sarah Gilbert 於 2021 年 3 月創立，總部位於英國迪德科特。

info.description: Draganfly, Inc. is a leader in cutting-edge drone solutions and software that are transforming industries and serving stakeholders globally. Its products include quad-copters, fixed wing aircrafts, ground based robots, hand held controllers, and software used for tracking, live streaming, and data collection. The firm also offers custom engineering, training, simulation consulting, as well as data and flight training services. The company was founded by Zenon Dragan and Christine Dragan in 1998 and is headquartered in Saskatoon, Canada.
info.description_zh: Draganfly, Inc. 是尖端無人機解決方案和軟體領域的領導者，致力於改變行業並為全球利益相關者提供服務。其產品包括四軸飛行器、固定翼飛機、地面機器人、手持控制器以及用於追蹤、直播和數據收集的軟體。該公司還提供客製化工程、培訓、模擬諮詢以及數據和飛行培訓服務。該公司由 Zenon Dragan 和 Christine Dragan 於 1998 年創立，總部位於加拿大薩斯卡通。

info.description: XORTX Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company. The firm engages in development and commercialization of innovative therapies. It focuses on drug therapies for rare orphan disease indications such as polycystic kidney disease, and the treatment of health consequences caused by chronic high serum uric acid or hyperuricemia, including Type 2 Diabetic Nephropathy, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. The company was founded by Allen Davidoff on May 31, 2011 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.description_zh: XORTX Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司。該公司從事創新療法的開發和商業化。它著重於罕見孤兒疾病適應症（如多囊性腎病變）的藥物治療，以及治療慢性高血清尿酸或高尿酸血症引起的健康後果，包括第2型糖尿病腎病變、心血管疾病和糖尿病。該公司由Allen Davidoff於2011年5月31日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: 20/20 Biolabs, Inc. engages in development and commercialization of proteomics product line. Its products include One Test, PAULA's Test and BioCheck Suspisious Powder Testing Kit. The company was founded by Jonathan Cohen in May 2000 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.

info.description: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF is an actively managed strategy designed to generate real returns and provide a direct hedge against rising inflation while minimizing the interest rate volatility typically associated with long-duration inflation-protected securities. The fund invests primarily in a diversified portfolio of short-term U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) and inflation-linked derivatives, utilizing PIMCO's macroeconomic research to tactically manage inflation breakeven positioning and duration.
info.description_zh: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF 是一種主動管理策略，旨在產生實際回報並提供對通膨上升的直接對沖，同時最大限度地減少通常與長期通膨保值證券相關的利率波動。該基金主要投資於短期美國國債通膨保值證券（TIPS）和通膨掛鉤衍生性商品的多元化投資組合，利用太平洋投資管理公司的宏觀經濟研究來戰術性地管理通膨盈虧平衡頭寸和久期。

The Residency Preparatory and Specialization Programs segment offers digital and printed medical content services, including online courses for residency preparatory, medical and other than medical post-graduate specialization programs and mobile app subscription for digital medical content. info.description_zh: Afya Ltd. 是一家醫學教育集團，致力於提供以醫生為中心的端到端生態系統，透過住院醫師準備、研究生課程和繼續醫學教育活動，為學生提供服務並使其成為終身醫學學習者。它透過教育服務機構運作；以及數位內容、住院醫師培訓準備和專業化課程部分。教育服務部門透過與醫學、其他健康科學和其他本科課程相關的本科生和研究生課程提供教育服務。住院醫師預備和專業課程部門提供數位和印刷醫學內容服務，包括住院醫師預備、醫學和非醫學研究生專業課程的線上課程以及數位醫療內容的行動應用程式訂閱。該公司成立於2019年3月22日，總部位於巴西新利馬。

info.description: iShares MSCI All Country Asia ex Japan ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI AC Asia ex Japan Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure equity market performance of securities from the following 10 developed and emerging market countries or regions: China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI All Country Asia（日本除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI AC Asia（日本除外）指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量以下 10 個已開發和新興市場國家或地區證券的股票市場表現：中國、香港、印度、印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡、韓國、台灣和泰國。

info.description: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company. It provides savings and loan banking services through its subsidiary, Catalyst Bank. The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Opelousas, LA.
info.description_zh: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司營運。它透過其子公司 Catalyst Bank 提供儲蓄和貸款銀行服務。該公司成立於 1922 年，總部位於路易斯安那州奧佩盧薩斯。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Focus Five Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector-based ETFs that the index provider believes offer the greatest potential to outperform the other ETFs in the selection universe and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Focus Five 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。該指數旨在提供對 First Trust 五個基於行業的 ETF 的有針對性的投資，指數提供者認為這些 ETF 具有超越精選範圍內其他 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Akari Therapeutics Plc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics to treat orphan autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded on October 7, 2004 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: Akari Therapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它致力於治療孤兒自體免疫疾病和發炎性疾病的療法的開發和商業化。該公司成立於2004年10月7日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: GRI Bio, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for inflammatory, fibrotic, and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on its lead program, GRI-0621, an inhibitor of type 1 invariant Natural Killer T (iNKT) cell activity and is being developed as a novel oral therapeutic for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded in May 2009 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: GRI Bio, Inc. 從事發炎、纖維化和自體免疫疾病療法的開發和商業化。該公司專注於其主導項目 GRI-0621，這是一種 1 型不變自然殺手 T (iNKT) 細胞活性抑制劑，正在開發為治療特發性肺纖維化的新型口服療法。該公司成立於 2009 年 5 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: Gamehaus Holdings, Inc. operates as a mobile game publishing company. It engages in partnering with small- and medium-sized game developers for game publishing solutions. The company was founded by Feng Xie on August 25, 2016 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Gamehaus Holdings, Inc. 是一家手機遊戲發行公司。它與中小型遊戲開發商合作提供遊戲發行解決方案。該公司由謝鋒於2016年8月25日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Ohmyhome Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in buying, selling, and renting real estate properties. It operates through the following business segments: Brokerage, Emerging, and Another Related Service; and Estate Management Services and Other Related Services. The Brokerage, Emerging, and Another Related Service segment refers to the provision of brokerage and documentation services for buying, selling, leasing, and renting properties. The Estate Management Services and Other Related Services provides estate management services for residential, commercial and industrial real estate in Singapore. The company was founded by Wan Chew Wong and Wan Pei Wong in 2016 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Ohmyhome Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事房地產買賣和租賃業務。它透過以下業務部門運作：經紀業務、新興業務和其他相關服務；及物業管理服務及其他相關服務。經紀、新興和其他相關服務部門是指為購買、出售、租賃和出租房產提供經紀和文件服務。物業管理服務及其他相關服務為新加坡的住宅、商業和工業房地產提供物業管理服務。該公司由 Wan Chew Wong 和 Wan Pei Wong 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Nano Labs Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in design and provision of product solution of fabless integrated circuit. It offers high throughput computing chips, high performance computing chips, distributed computing and storage solutions, smart network interface cards, vision computing chips, and distributed rendering. The company was founded in July 2019 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Nano Labs Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事無晶圓廠積體電路設計和產品解決方案提供。它提供高吞吐量運算晶片、高效能運算晶片、分散式運算和儲存解決方案、智慧型網路介面卡、視覺運算晶片和分散式渲染。公司成立於2019年7月，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: ImmunityBio, Inc. is a clinical stage immunotherapy company. It develops next generation therapies that drive immunogenic mechanisms for defeating cancers and infectious diseases. The company's immunotherapy platform activates both the innate and adaptive immune systems to create long term immunological memory. ImmunityBio was founded by Patrick Soon-Shiong in 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: ImmunityBio, Inc.是一家臨床階段免疫療法公司。它開發下一代療法，驅動免疫原性機制來戰勝癌症和傳染病。該公司的免疫治療平台可激活先天性和適應性免疫系統，以創建長期免疫記憶。 ImmunityBio 由 Patrick Soon-Shiong 於 2014 年創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solution services. It provides tailor-made software solutions, cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) services, and white-labelled software design and development services. The company was founded by Kin Pong Shek on July 13, 2023, and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Wellchange Holdings Co. Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供企業軟體解決方案服務。它提供量身定制的軟體解決方案、基於雲端的軟體即服務（SaaS）服務以及白標軟體設計和開發服務。該公司由Kin Pong Shek於2023年7月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: NOVONIX Ltd. engages in the revolutionizing the global lithium-ion battery industry with innovative, sustainable technologies, high-performance materials, and more efficient production methods. The firm manufactures industry battery cell testing equipment, is growing its high-performance synthetic graphite material manufacturing operations, and has developed a patented all-dry, zero-waste cathode synthesis process. The firm operates through the following segments: Battery Materials, Battery Technology, and Graphite Exploration. NOVONIX was founded by Gregory Alexander John Baynton in April 2012 and is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
info.description_zh: NOVONIX Ltd. 致力於透過創新、永續技術、高性能材料和更有效率的生產方法徹底改變全球鋰離子電池產業。該公司製造工業電池測試設備，正在發展其高性能合成石墨材料製造業務，並開發了專利的全乾式、零廢物陰極合成流程。該公司透過以下部門運作：電池材料、電池技術和石墨勘探。 NOVONIX 由 Gregory Alexander John Baynton 於 2012 年 4 月創立，總部位於澳洲布里斯班。

info.description: Founder-Led 2x Daily ETF is an actively managed fund seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to 200% of the daily performance of the Founder-Led Index. The strategy targets a basket of the largest U.S. publicly traded companies where at least one original founder currently serves in a key executive leadership role, utilizing daily leverage to magnify price movements of these firms.
info.description_zh: 創辦人主導的 2x 每日 ETF 是一款積極管理的基金，尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於創始人主導的指數每日表現的 200%。該策略針對一籃子美國最大的上市公司，其中至少有一名原始創辦人目前擔任關鍵的執行領導角色，利用每日槓桿來放大這些公司的價格變動。

info.description: Acorn Energy, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of technology driven solutions for energy infrastructure asset management. It operates through the Power Generation (PG) and Cathodic Protection (CP) segments. The PG segment offers wireless remote monitoring and control systems and services for critical assets, as well as Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The CP segment includes remote monitoring of cathodic protection systems on gas pipelines for gas utilities and pipeline companies. The company was founded by George Morgenstern in 1986 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Acorn Energy, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為能源基礎設施資產管理提供技術驅動的解決方案。它透過發電（PG）和陰極保護（CP）部門運作。 PG 部門為關鍵資產以及物聯網 (IoT) 應用提供無線遠端監控和控制系統及服務。陰極保護領域包括為天然氣公用事業公司和管道公司提供天然氣管道陰極保護系統的遠端監控。該公司由 George Morgenstern 於 1986 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: ZK International Group Co., Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sales of stainless steel band, copper strip, welded stainless steel pipes and fittings, valve, light industry machinery equipment, and other stainless steel products. The company was founded by Jian Cong Huang and Guo Lin Wang on May 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 中康國際集團有限公司是一家控股公司，主要從事不銹鋼帶、銅帶、不銹鋼焊接管材及管件、閥門、輕工業機械設備等不銹鋼產品的製造和銷售。該公司由黃健聰和王果林於2015年5月13日創立，總部位於中國溫州。

info.description: Sound Group, Inc. is a global, AI-powered audio company on a mission to help people connect better and live happier. Leveraging its voice AI technologies and deep expertise in audio interaction, Sound Group is building a diverse ecosystem of intelligent audio products that cater to a global user base. By integrating technology, innovative products, and real-world data within a user-centric ecosystem, Sound Group generates a powerful growth flywheel that is driving continuous innovation and accelerating global expansion. The company was founded by Jinnan Lai and Ning Ding in 2010 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Sound Group, Inc. 是一家由人工智慧驅動的全球音訊公司，其使命是幫助人們更好地聯繫、更快樂地生活。憑藉其語音人工智慧技術和在音訊互動領域的深厚專業知識，Sound Group 正在建立一個多元化的智慧音訊產品生態系統，以滿足全球用戶群的需求。透過將技術、創新產品和現實世界數據整合到以用戶為中心的生態系統中，Sound Group 形成了強大的成長飛輪，推動持續創新並加速全球擴張。該公司由賴金南和丁寧於2010年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Global X Blockchain ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Blockchain Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes (if any), in the securities of the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of blockchain technology. The fund is non-diversified.

It also offers electric two and four-wheel motorcycles and utility terrain vehicles. The company was founded by Christian Gerard Okonsky and Adrian James on February 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Round Rock, TX.
