info.description_zh: Empery Digital, Inc. 從事電動戶外動力運動車的設計與開發。它還提供電動兩輪和四輪摩托車以及多功能越野車。該公司由 Christian Gerard Okonsky 和 ​​Adrian James 於 2020 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州朗德羅克。

info.description: Femasys, Inc. is a biomedical company, which engages in the development of novel solutions for reproductive healthcare. The company was founded by Kathy Lee-Sepsick in 2004 and is headquartered in Suwanee, GA.
info.description_zh: Femasys, Inc. 是一家生物醫學公司，致力於開發生殖保健的新型解決方案。該公司由 Kathy Lee-Sepsick 於 2004 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州蘇萬尼。

info.description: Future FinTech Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operation of a real name blockchain based e-commerce platform. Its activities include a blockchain-based online shopping mall platform, Chain Cloud Mall (CCM), a cross-border e-commerce platform (NONOGIRL), an incubator for blockchain based application projects, and a digital payment system (DCON). It operates through the following segments: Supply Chain Financing/Trading, Brokerage Service, and Others. The company was founded on June 29, 1998 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Future FinTech Group, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事基於實名區塊鏈的電子商務平台的營運。其活動包括基於區塊鏈的線上購物中心平台Chain Cloud Mall（CCM）、跨境電子商務平台（NONOGIRL）、基於區塊鏈的應用專案孵化器以及數位支付系統（DCON）。它透過以下部門運作：供應鏈融資/貿易、經紀服務和其他。該公司成立於1998年6月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: TAO Synergies Inc. is engaged in the convergence between cryptocurrency and artificial intelligence. It also focuses on research and development activities related to developing therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded on October 31, 2012 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: TAO Synergies Inc. 致力於加密貨幣與人工智慧的整合。它還專注於與開發神經退化性疾病療法相關的研究和開發活動。該公司成立於2012年10月31日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long OKTA Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of OKTA. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of OKTA, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 OKTA 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 OKTA 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 OKTA 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale oil seeds through its subsidiaries. It focuses on acquiring, engaging in a share exchange, share reconstruction, and amalgamation with, purchasing all or substantially all the assets of, entering contractual arrangements with, or engaging in any other similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on December 29, 2022 and is headquartered in Cootamundra, Australia.
info.description_zh: 澳洲油籽控股有限公司透過其子公司從事油籽生產和銷售。它的重點是收購一個或多個企業或實體、進行股份交換、股份重組、合併、購買其全部或幾乎所有資產、與其簽訂合約安排或進行任何其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2022年12月29日，總部位於澳洲庫塔曼德拉。

info.description: Hadron Energy, Inc. is a nuclear technology company. It focuses on developing compact micro-modular nuclear reactors (MMRs) designed to provide continuous, carbon-free power for high-demand applications. The company was founded by Samuel Gibson in May 2024 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Hadron Energy, Inc.是一家核子技術公司。它專注於開發緊湊型微型模組化核反應器（MMR），旨在為高需求應用提供連續、無碳的電力。該公司由 Samuel Gibson 於 2024 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Smartbird, Inc. is a global lifestyle brand that innovates with naturally derived materials to make footwear and apparel products in a better way, while treading lighter on the planet. It offers Men's Shoes, Women's Shoes, Men's Apparel, Women's Apparel, Socks, and Gift Cards. The company was founded by Timothy Brown and Joseph Zev Zwillinger on May 6, 2015 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Smartbird, Inc. 是一個全球生活風格品牌，利用天然材料進行創新，以更好的方式製造鞋類和服裝產品，同時在地球上邁出更輕的腳步。它提供男鞋、女鞋、男裝、女裝、襪子和禮品卡。該公司由 Timothy Brown 和 Joseph Zev Zwillinger 於 2015 年 5 月 6 日創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Valion Bio, Inc. operates as a bio-electronic health-tech company, which develops micro current therapy solutions for chronic diseases and conditions. The company was founded by Jennifer Ernst and John Claude on September 22, 2016 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: Valion Bio, Inc. 是一家生物電子健康科技公司，致力於開發針對慢性疾病和病症的微電流治療解決方案。該公司由 Jennifer Ernst 和 John Claude 於 2016 年 9 月 22 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: SkyAI, Inc. engages in providing an agentic finance platform. It focuses on stablecoin rails with agentic artificial intelligence (AI) to deliver financial access, education, and actionable intelligence to Africa, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. The company was founded by Alan R. Blackman and Barry B. Berler on December 16, 2017 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: SkyAI, Inc. 致力於提供代理金融平台。它專注於具有代理人工智慧（AI）的穩定幣軌道，為非洲、拉丁美洲和東南亞提供金融服務、教育和可操作的情報。該公司由 Alan R. Blackman 和 Barry B. Berler 於 2017 年 12 月 16 日創立，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: BGM Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the technology fields of AI application, intelligent robots, algorithmic computing power, cloud computing, and biopharmaceuticals. It operates through the following segments: Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and Traditional Chinese Medicine Derivatives (TCMD); Heparin Products and Sausage Casing; and Fertilizer. The Oxytetracycline and Licorice Products, and TCMD segment focuses on the development, manufacture, marketing, and sale of oxytetracycline products, licorice products, and TCMD. The Heparin Products and Sausage Casing segment treats cardiovascular diseases, cerebrovascular diseases, and hemodialysis. The Fertilizer segment includes Xiongguan, Organic Fertilizer and Xiongguan, and Organic-Inorganic Compound Fertilizer. The company was founded on February 7, 2019 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BGM Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，涉足人工智慧應用、智慧機器人、演算法算力、雲端運算、生物製藥等技術領域。它透過以下部門運作：土黴素和甘草產品部門，以及中藥衍生品部門（TCMD）；肝素產品和腸衣；和肥料。土黴素和甘草產品以及TCMD部門專注於土黴素產品、甘草產品和TCMD的開發、製造、行銷和銷售。肝素產品和腸衣部門治療心血管疾病、腦血管疾病和血液透析。肥料業務包括雄冠、有機肥料和雄冠、有機無機復混肥。公司成立於2019年2月7日，總部位於中國成都。

info.description: Atlantic American Corp. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the life, health, and property and casualty insurance industries. It operates through the following segments: American Southern, Bankers Fidelity, and Corporate & Other. The American Southern segment operates in the property and casualty insurance market. The Bankers Fidelity segment operates in the life and health insurance market. The Corporate and Other segment is from external sources. The company was founded on January 4, 1968 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Atlantic American Corp.是一家保險控股公司，從事人壽、健康、財產和意外保險業。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國南方航空、富達銀行和企業及其他部門。美國南方分部從事財產和意外保險市場。 Bankers Fidelity 部門在人壽保險和健康保險市場開展業務。公司及其他部門來自外部來源。該公司成立於 1968 年 1 月 4 日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: WeShop Holdings Ltd. engages in providing a shoppable social network. It offers shopping in fashion and accessories, health and beauty, home and DIY, food and drink, travel and holidays, tech and electronics, and other popular categories. It includes a library of shoppable product reviews from a digital online shopping mall on mobile devices. The company was founded by John Garner on September 21, 2012 and is headquartered in Jersey, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: WeShop Holdings Ltd. 致力於提供可購物的社交網路。它提供時尚和配件、健康和美容、家居和 DIY、食品和飲料、旅遊和度假、科技和電子產品以及其他熱門類別的購物。它包括來自行動裝置上的數位線上購物中心的可購物產品評論庫。該公司由約翰·加納於2012年9月21日創立，總部位於英國澤西島。

info.description: Minerva Neurosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of a portfolio of product candidates to treat central nervous system diseases. It develops Roluperidone for the treatment of negative symptoms in patients with schizophrenia and MIN-301 for the treatment of Parkinson's disease. The company was founded by Rogerio Vivaldi Coelho and Goeffrey Robin Race on April 23, 2007 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Minerva Neurosciences, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於治療中樞神經系統疾病的候選產品組合的開發和商業化。該公司開發用於治療精神分裂症患者陰性症狀的 Roluperidone 和用於治療帕金森氏症的 MIN-301。該公司由 Rogerio Vivaldi Coelho 和 Goeffrey Robin Race 於 2007 年 4 月 23 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. engages in the development and commercialization of drugs for gastrointestinal (GI), infectious diseases, and oncology. The firm's products include Talicia, Movantik, and Aemcolo. It operates through the Commercial Operations and Research and Development segments. The Commercial Operations segment covers areas relating to commercial sales through a subsidiary in the United States. The Research and Development segment includes the study and licensing of therapeutic candidates. The company was founded by Dror Ben-Asher and Ori Shilo on August 3, 2009 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. 從事胃腸道 (GI)、傳染病和腫瘤學藥物的開發和商業化。該公司的產品包括 Talicia、Movantik 和 Aemcolo。它透過商業營運和研發部門進行運作。商業營運部門涵蓋與透過美國子公司進行商業銷售相關的領域。研究與開發部門包括候選治療藥物的研究和許可。該公司由 Dror Ben-Asher 和 Ori Shilo 於 2009 年 8 月 3 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Fold Holdings, Inc. engages in providing Bitcoin-focused financial services. The company was founded on February 14, 2025 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Fold Holdings, Inc. 致力於提供以比特幣為中心的金融服務。該公司成立於2025年2月14日，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: Vince Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture, design, and sale of luxury apparel and accessories. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Direct-to-Consumer, and Rebecca Taylor and Parker. The Wholesale segment deals with the sale of products to premier department stores and specialty stores in the U.S. and in selected international markets. The Direct-to-Consumer segment includes retail and outlet stores and its e-commerce business. The company was founded by Rea Laccone and Christopher LaPolice in 2002 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Vince Holding Corp. 從事奢華服裝和配件的製造、設計和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：批發部門、直接面向消費者部門以及麗貝卡泰勒和帕克部門。批發部門負責向美國和選定的國際市場的頂級百貨公司和專賣店銷售產品。直接面向消費者部門包括零售店和直銷店及其電子商務業務。該公司由 Rea Laccone 和 Christopher LaPolice 於 2002 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Core AI Holdings, Inc. engages in mobile game development and publishing. It creates games for players worldwide while empowering other developers to deliver player-focused apps and games to enthusiasts. It focuses on harnessing the power of artificial intelligence to build transformative and scalable offerings across multiple verticals. The company was founded by Marc Seelenfreund on October 15, 1986 and is headquartered in Surrey, Canada.
info.description_zh: Core AI Holdings, Inc.從事手機遊戲開發和發行。它為世界各地的玩家創造遊戲，同時幫助其他開發者向愛好者提供以玩家為中心的應用程式和遊戲。它專注於利用人工智慧的力量在多個垂直領域中建立變革性和可擴展的產品。該公司由Marc Seelenfreund於1986年10月15日創立，總部位於加拿大薩裡。

info.description: One & One Green Technologies, Inc. engages in the recycling, production, and trading of recycled scrap metals. Its products include copper alloy ingot, recycled aluminum, recycled tin, recycled zinc, recycled iron, and plastic beads. The company was founded on April 17, 2024 and is headquartered in Bulacan, Philippines.
info.description_zh: One & One Green Technologies, Inc. 從事再生廢金屬的回收、生產和貿易。其產品包括銅合金錠、再生鋁、再生錫、再生鋅、再生鐵和塑膠珠。該公司成立於2024年4月17日，總部位於菲律賓布拉幹省。

info.description: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. is a self-managed real estate investment trust, which invests in a diverse multi-tenant portfolio of real estate assets. It operates through the following segments: Office and Industrial Properties, Model Home Properties, and Retail Properties. The Office and Industrial Properties segment consists of office buildings and an industrial property leased to a variety of tenants ranging from small businesses to large public companies. The Model Home Properties segment consists of model home residential properties leased to homebuilders. The Retail Properties segment includes shopping centers. The company was founded by Jack Kendrick Heilbron on September 28, 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. 是一家自我管理的房地產投資信託公司，投資於多元化的多租戶房地產資產組合。它透過以下部門運作：辦公室和工業地產、樣板房地產和零售地產。辦公和工業地產部門包括辦公大樓和工業地產，租賃給從小型企業到大型上市公司等各種租戶。樣品屋物業部門包括出租給房屋建築商的樣品屋住宅物業。零售物業部門包括購物中心。該公司由 Jack Kendrick Heilbron 於 1999 年 9 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Taoping, Inc. operates as block chain technology and smart cloud services provider. It operates through the following segments: Cloud-based Technology, Blockchain Technology, Traditional Information Technology. The CBT segment includes the company's cloud based products and data storage related services sold to private sectors. The BT segment is the company's Crypto currency mining initiative. The TIT segment is involved in the company's project-based technology products and services sold to the public sector such as Geographic Information System, Digital Public Security Technology, and Digital Hospital Information Systems. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 淘屏公司是一家區塊鏈技術和智慧雲端服務提供商。它透過以下部門運作：基於雲端的技術、區塊鏈技術、傳統資訊技術。 CBT 部門包括該公司向私營部門出售的基於雲端的產品和資料儲存相關服務。 BT 部門是該公司的加密貨幣挖礦計劃。 TIT部門涉及該公司向公共部門銷售的基於專案的技術產品和服務，例如地理資訊系統、數位公共安全技術和數位醫院資訊系統。該公司成立於1993年，總部位於香港。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FIG Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of FIG. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of FIG, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund manager will attempt to achieve its investment objective without regard to overall market movement or the increase or decrease in the value of FIG. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍長期Fig 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為Fig 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，符合FIG 的價格，與基金的投資目標一致。基金管理人將嘗試實現其投資目標，而不考慮整體市場走勢或圖值的增加或減少。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nocera, Inc. is a holding company, which through its subsidiary engages in the aquaculture consulting and management business. Its services include design, install, build, and manage aquaculture investment and projects; pilot and management services to aquaculture companies and new aquaculture projects; and offers equipment and materials from suppliers. The company was founded on February 1, 2002 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: Nocera, Inc.是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事水產養殖諮詢和管理業務。其服務包括設計、安裝、建造和管理水產養殖投資和專案；為水產養殖公司和新水產養殖專案提供試點和管理服務；並提供來自供應商的設備和材料。公司成立於2002年2月1日，總部位於台灣新北市。

info.description: Fangdd Network Group Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of real estate information services through its online platform. It also offers integrated marketing services for individual customers, real estate developers, and agents. The company was founded by Yi Duan, Xi Zeng, and Jian Cheng Li in October 2011 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 房多多網路集團有限公司是一家投資控股公司，透過其線上平台提供房地產資訊服務。它還為個人客戶、房地產開發商和代理商提供整合行銷服務。該公司由段毅、曾熙和李建成於2011年10月創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Fingermotion Inc. is a mobile data specialist company, which engages in the provision of payment and recharge service, data plans, subscription plans, mobile phones, loyalty points redemption, and other product bundles. It operates through the following segments: Telecommunications and Product Services, Value Added Products and Services, Short Message Services and Multimedia Messaging Services, Rich Communication Services Platform, and Big Data Insights. The company was founded on January 23, 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Fingermotion Inc.是一家行動數據專業公司，提供支付和儲值服務、數據計劃、訂閱計劃、手機、忠誠積分兌換和其他產品捆綁。它透過以下部門運作：電信和產品服務、增值產品和服務、簡訊服務和多媒體訊息服務、豐富的通訊服務平台和大數據洞察。該公司成立於2014年1月23日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Propanc Biopharma, Inc. is a development-stage healthcare company, which engages in the research and development of cancer treatments. The firm focuses on the treatment of pancreatic, ovarian, and colorectal cancer. It offers its product pipeline, including PRP and POP1. The company was founded by James Nathanielsz and Julian Kenyon on October 15, 2007 and is headquartered in Camberwell, Australia.
info.description_zh: Propanc Biopharma, Inc.是一家處於發展階段的醫療保健公司，從事癌症治療的研究和開發。該公司專注於胰腺癌、卵巢癌和大腸癌的治療。它提供其產品線，包括 PRP 和 POP1。該公司由 James Nathanielsz 和 Julian Kenyon 於 2007 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於澳洲坎伯韋爾。

info.description: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd. is a technology company which involves in AI for Better water utilizing AI technology to provide better drinking water solutions for households worldwide. The firm involves in home water systems, Viomi has developed a distinctive Equipment and Consumables business model. It operates a Water Purifier Gigafactory with an integrated industrial chain that boasts optimal efficiency and facilitates continuous breakthroughs in water purification. The company was founded by Xiao Ping Chen in May 2014 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 雲米科技有限公司是一家涉足AI for Better Water的科技公司，利用AI技術為全球家庭提供更好的飲用水解決方案。該公司涉足家庭水系統，雲米開發了獨特的設備和耗材商業模式。旗下擁有全產業鏈的淨水器超級工廠，效率最優，協助淨水領域不斷突破。該公司由陳曉平於2014年5月創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: ENDRA Life Sciences, Inc. engages in the development of medical devices for accurate liver fat measurement for use in metabolic disease detection and GLP-1 drug eligibility and management. The company was founded on July 18, 2007 and is headquartered in Ann Arbor, MI.
info.description_zh: ENDRA Life Sciences, Inc. 致力於開發用於準確測量肝臟脂肪的醫療設備，用於代謝疾病檢測以及 GLP-1 藥物資格和管理。該公司成立於2007年7月18日，總部位於密西根州安娜堡。

info.description: Artelo Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development of therapeutics that target lipid-signaling pathways, including the endocannabinoid system. Its product candidate pipeline includes ART27.13-Synthetic Cannabinoid Agonist, ART26.12-FABP5 inhibitor, and ART12.11-Synthetic CBD Cocrystal. The company was founded on May 2, 2011 and is headquartered in Solana Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: Artelo Biosciences, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於開發脂質訊號路徑（包括內源性大麻素系統）的療法。其候選產品管道包括 ART27.13-合成大麻素激動劑、ART26.12-FABP5 抑制劑和 ART12.11-合成 CBD Cocrystal。該公司成立於2011年5月2日，總部位於加州索拉納海灘。

info.description: CalciMedica, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing therapies for life-threatening inflammatory diseases. The firm's product candidate, Auxora, helps in treating acute pancreatitis and asparaginase-associated pancreatitis. The company was founded by Kenneth A. Stauderman and Gonul Velicelebi in 2007 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: CalciMedica, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發危及生命的發炎性疾病的療法。該公司的候選產品 Auxora 有助於治療急性胰臟炎和天冬酰胺酶相關胰臟炎。該公司由 Kenneth A. Stauderman 和 Gonul Velicelebi 於 2007 年創立，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: Range Capital Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on May 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Cold Spring Harbor, NY.
info.description_zh: Range Capital Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年5月22日，總部位於紐約州冷泉港。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics SPAC Active ETF seeks to generate realized capital gains in excess of short-term interest rates on a risk adjusted basis. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund that pursues its investment objective primarily by investing, under normal circumstances, in special purpose acquisition companies ("SPACs") that, the fund's investment sub-adviser, believes will generate net realized capital gains in excess of the income derived from bank certificates of deposit with similar maturities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics SPAC Active ETF 尋求在風險調整的基礎上產生超過短期利率的已實現資本利得。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，在正常情況下主要透過投資特殊目的收購公司（「SPAC」）來實現其投資目標，該基金的投資副顧問認為，這些公司所產生的已實現淨資本利得將超過類似期限的銀行存單所產生的收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment and Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment. The Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical, and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products in the United States. The Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health brand medical, surgical, and laboratory products, which are sold in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia, and other markets. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和專業解決方案部門以及全球醫療產品和分銷部門運營。製藥和專業解決方案部門在美國分銷品牌和仿製藥、專業藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。全球醫療產品和分銷部門生產、採購和分銷 Cardinal Health 品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品，這些產品銷往美國、加拿大、歐洲、亞洲和其他市場。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: Ulta Beauty, Inc. engages in the retail of beauty products. The firm also includes salon and e-commerce services. Its products include makeup, skin care, tools and brushes, fragrance, and bath and body. The company was founded on January 9, 1990 and is headquartered in Bolingbrook, IL.

info.description_zh: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年9月28日，總部位於加州丹維爾。

info.description: Gesher Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 30, 2024 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Gesher Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年8月30日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: The Honest Co., Inc. is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. The company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. The Honest Co., Inc. was founded by Jessica Alba, Christopher Gavigan, Sean Kane, Brian S. Lee, and Jessica Marie Warren in 2011 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: The Honest Co., Inc. 是一家個人護理公司，致力於創造清潔配方和永續設計的產品，涵蓋尿布、濕紙巾、嬰兒個人護理、美容、服裝、家庭護理和健康等類別。公司的使命是透過誠實品牌、誠實團隊和誠實標準的力量挑戰成分、理想和行業。 The Honest Co., Inc. 由 Jessica Alba、Christopher Gavigan、Sean Kane、Brian S. Lee 和 Jessica Marie Warren 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: LightWave Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: LightWave Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年1月22日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Quetta Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on May 1, 2023 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Quetta Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2023年5月1日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: SIM Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 29, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SIM Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其創建目的是為了實現與一個或多個企業的合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年1月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: SL Science Holding Ltd. operates as a biomedical company. It operates through Exosome products, CD-19 Armed-T products, GDT cell therapy products, corporate and unallocated segments. The firm offers immune cell development, skincare product formulations, cellular and gene therapies. The company was founded by Ching Dong Wang on March 18, 2025 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

The firm develops sulfide-based solid-electrolyte material technology that replaces the liquid or gel electrolyte used in traditional lithium-ion battery cells. It focuses on the development and commercialization of all-solid-state battery cells and solid-electrolyte materials, primarily for the battery-powered electric vehicle market. The company was founded on August 3, 2011 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.

info.description: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII is a blank check company. The firm was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cove, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII 是一家空白支票公司。該公司的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 7 月 15 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cove。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBoost MSTR ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on MicroStrategy Inc.'s common stock (NASDAQ: MSTR) by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBoost MSTR ETF 旨在透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收益是透過出售 MicroStrategy Inc. 普通股（NASDAQ：MSTR）選擇權產生的，該基金旨在實現標的股票每日表現的 2 倍 (200%) 並獲得標準的槓桿收益限制的表現上限。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的槓桿ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: eToro Group Ltd. engages in the development, management, and provision of online trading software solutions and services. The firm's trading platform, eToro, allows users to trade financial instruments. It also enables non-professionals to trade in markets that were previously the exclusive arena of professional investors. The company was founded by Johnathan Alexander Assia, Guy Gamzu, David Ring, and Ronen Assia on December 14, 2006 and is headquartered in Bnei Braq, Israel.
info.description_zh: eToro Group Ltd. 從事開發、管理和提供線上交易軟體解決方案和服務。該公司的交易平台 eToro 允許用戶交易金融工具。它還使非專業人士能夠在以前專業投資者專屬的市場上進行交易。該公司由 Johnathan Alexander Assia、Guy Gamzu、David Ring 和 Ronen Assia 於 2006 年 12 月 14 日創立，總部位於以色列 Bnei Braq。

info.description: IM Cannabis Corp. engages in the production and sale of medical cannabis products. It offers dry flower products and cannabis oil products under the IMC brand. The company was founded on March 7, 1980 and is headquartered in Glil Yam, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: IM Cannabis Corp. 從事醫用大麻產品的生產和銷售。它以 IMC 品牌提供乾燥花產品和大麻油產品。該公司成立於1980年3月7日，總部位於以色列Glil Yam。

info.description: Xometry, Inc. offers an AI-powered marketplace, the popular Thomasnet industrial sourcing platform, and a suite of cloud-based services. Xometry's marketplaces use proprietary AI to help buyers efficiently source custom-manufactured parts and assemblies and attain instant pricing and lead times. The AI enables a rapidly growing network of manufacturers to select the optimal jobs to fill capacity. The firm's suite of cloud-based services and Thomasnet industrial sourcing platform help manufacturers and industrial service providers grow businesses using advertising, marketing, and financial services. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States and International. The company was founded by Laurence Zuriff and Randolph Altschuler in 2013 and is headquartered in North Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Xometry, Inc. 提供人工智慧驅動的市場、受歡迎的 Thomasnet 工業採購平台以及一套基於雲端的服務。 Xometry 的市場使用專有的人工智慧來幫助買家有效地購買客製化製造的零件和組件，並獲得即時定價和交貨時間。人工智慧使快速成長的製造商網路能夠選擇最佳工作來填補產能。該公司的基於雲端的服務套件和 Thomasnet 工業採購平台可協助製造商和工業服務供應商利用廣告、行銷和金融服務發展業務。它透過以下地理部門運作：美國和國際。該公司由 Laurence Zuriff 和 Randolph Altschuler 於 2013 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州北貝塞斯達。

info.description: Bolt Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer. Its pipeline includes BDC-1001, a HER2-targeting Boltbody Immune-Stimulating Antibody Conjugate (ISAC), BDC-3042, a myeloid-modulating antibody, and multiple Boltbody ISAC collaboration programs. The company was founded by Edgar G. Engleman on January 22, 2015 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.

info.description_zh: Bolt Biotherapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，開發用於治療癌症的新型免疫療法。其管道包括BDC-1001（一種針對HER2的Boltbody免疫刺激抗體偶聯物（ISAC））、BDC-3042（一種骨髓調節抗體）和多個Boltbody ISAC合作計畫。該公司由 Edgar G. Engleman 於 2015 年 1 月 22 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: HCW Biologics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel immunotherapies to lengthen health span by disrupting the link between chronic, low-grade inflammation, and age-related diseases. The firm considers age-related low-grade chronic inflammation as a contributing factor to several chronic diseases and conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, neurodegenerative diseases, and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Hing C. Wong on April 2, 2018 and is headquartered in Miramar, FL.
info.description_zh: HCW Biologics Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，專注於發現和開發新型免疫療法，透過破壞慢性、低度發炎和年齡相關疾病之間的關聯來延長健康壽命。該公司認為與年齡相關的低度慢性發炎是導致多種慢性疾病和病症的因素，例如癌症、心血管疾病、糖尿病、神經退化性疾病和自體免疫疾病。該公司由 Hing C. Wong 於 2018 年 4 月 2 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州米拉瑪。

info.description: Veea, Inc. is a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) company, which engages in the sale of smart computing hubs and related subscriptions and licenses. Its solutions include digital inclusion, connected buildings, precision agriculture, TROLLEE, and Internet-of-Things (IoT) and Industrial internet of things (IIoT) connectivity. The company was founded by Allen B. Salmasi and Michael Salmasi in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Veea, Inc. 是一家平台即服務 (PaaS) 公司，從事智慧運算中心及相關訂閱和授權的銷售。其解決方案包括數位包容、互聯建築、精準農業、TROLLEE、物聯網 (IoT) 和工業物聯網 (IIoT) 連接。該公司由 Allen B. Salmasi 和 Michael Salmasi 於 2014 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Themes Cybersecurity ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of Solactive Cyber Security Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the cybersecurity industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Cyber​​security ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Cyber​​ Security Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為在網路安全產業開展業務的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Xtrackers Cybersecurity Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Cyber Security ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the field of cybersecurity and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Cyber​​security Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Cyber​​ Security ESG 篩選指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數化投資方法，尋求與相關指數（扣除費用和開支之前）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在網路安全領域開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Cybersecurity ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Cybersecurity Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from increased adoption of cybersecurity technology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Cyber​​security ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 網路安全指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該指數旨在為那些能夠從網路安全技術的採用增加中受益的交易所上市公司提供投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nexalin Technology, Inc. designs and develops neurostimulation products. Its medical devices help people with mental health illness. The company was founded by John Patrick Claude on October 19, 2010 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Nexalin Technology, Inc. 設計和開發神經刺激產品。其醫療設備可以幫助患有精神疾病的人。該公司由 John Patrick Claude 於 2010 年 10 月 19 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Alps Group, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company that integrates research and development, medical services, and wellness solutions. The company focuses on creating a fair healthcare ecosystem, to make advance predictive, preventive, and precision medicine accessible and affordable. The company is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: Alps Group, Inc. 是一家集研發、醫療服務和健康解決方案於一體的生技公司。该公司致力于创建一个公平的医疗保健生态系统，使先进的预测性、预防性和精准医疗变得容易获得且负担得起。該公司總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity products and services to stop breaches. It offers cloud-delivered protection across endpoints, cloud workloads, identity and data, and threat intelligence, managed security services, IT operations management, threat hunting, Zero Trust identity protection, and log management. CrowdStrike serves customers worldwide. The company was founded by George P. Kurtz, Gregg Marston, and Dmitri Alperovitch on November 7, 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. 提供網路安全產品和服務來阻止違規行為。它提供跨端點、雲端工作負載、身分和資料以及威脅情報、託管安全服務、IT 營運管理、威脅搜尋、零信任身分保護和日誌管理的雲端交付保護。 CrowdStrike 為全球客戶提供服務。該公司由 George P. Kurtz、Gregg Marston 和 Dmitri Alperovitch 於 2011 年 11 月 7 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of design and development of integrated circuits and electronic devices. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Asia, EMEA, and Japan. The company was founded by Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli, Gudmundur A. Hjartarson, K. Bobby Chao, and K. Charles Janac in June 1988 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. 從事積體電路和電子設備的設計和開發。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和日本。該公司由 Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli、Gudmundur A. Hjartarson、K. Bobby Chao 和 K. Charles Janac 於 1988 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. engages in the provision of network security solutions to enterprises, service providers, and government entities. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, Israel, and Other Countries. The company was founded by Nir Zuk in March 2005 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. 致力於為企業、服務供應商和政府實體提供網路安全解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、以色列和其他國家。該公司由 Nir ​​Zuk 於 2005 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Yimutian, Inc. is a holding company which engages in the provision of agricultural business-to-business (B2B) platform. It offers digital solutions to facilitate agricultural product transactions, ranging from searching, matching, to transaction facilitation, and settlement. The company was founded by Jin Hong Deng, Zhi Jia Liu, and Mi Zhou on August 1, 2011 and is headquartered on Beijing, China.

Its property portfolio includes income producing, strip centers, neighborhood, grocery-anchored, community, and free-standing retail properties. The company was founded on June 23, 2011 and is headquartered in Virginia Beach, VA.

info.description_zh: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. 從事零售物業的收購、融資、開發、租賃、所有權和管理。其物業組合包括創收物業、地帶中心、社區、雜貨店、社區和獨立零售物業。該公司成立於2011年6月23日，總部位於維吉尼亞州維吉尼亞海灘。
